network_status.network: Eventi idrogeologici storici in Valle d'Aosta
network_status.summary_it: La fonte regionale documenta due effetti distinti in Valsavarenche: Pont du Loup abbattuto e ponte di Mesoncles gravemente danneggiato. Il secondo record ARCUS è anch'esso classificato come crollo totale sul Maisoncle, senza una corrispondenza univoca con la cronologia ufficiale; ARCUS segnala il conflitto e non forza una misura di evento.
network_status.summary_en: The regional source documents two distinct effects in Valsavarenche: Pont du Loup swept away and the Mesoncles bridge severely damaged. The second ARCUS record is also classified as a total collapse on the Maisoncle without an unambiguous match to the official chronology; ARCUS flags the conflict and does not force an event measurement.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
